title: GL-18 — ECS on Fargate
beforeYouStart: Cost basis (us-east-1, priced 2026-09-29): 1 Fargate task: 0.25 vCPU at $0.0405 per vCPU-hour + 0.5 GB at $0.00445 per GB-hour ≈ $0.0124/h, plus 1 public IPv4 $0.005/h. This run ≈ $0.03; forgotten 24 h ≈ $0.42 (at least; data transfer not included). Re-check current pricing before you run.
stopChargesPanel: Stop tasks, delete service if any, deregister task defs, delete cluster. Forgotten 24 h: at least $0.42 (see the cost basis).

steps.title: Set the profile and region
bullets: In PowerShell run `$env:AWS_PROFILE = 'your-lab-profile'` using a named profile, not root.
Run `$env:AWS_REGION = 'us-east-1'`.
Success: both variables print the expected values.

steps.title: Confirm who is signed in
bullets: Run `aws sts get-caller-identity`.
Success: Arn contains `:user/` or `:assumed-role/`, not `:root`.
Set `$AccountId` from the Account field.

steps.title: Confirm AWS CLI v2
bullets: Run `aws --version`.
Success: output starts with `aws-cli/2`.
This lab focuses on ECS Fargate; Terraform is not required unless a step says so.

steps.title: Read the cost estimate
bullets: Open this lab's same-hour and forgotten-24h estimates in the card header.
Success: you can state both numbers before creating billable resources.
Budget alerts from GL-01 warn only; they do not stop spend.

steps.title: Accept cost risk
bullets: In the lab card, open the cost-risk box and type `I ACCEPT THE COST RISK` exactly as shown.
Success: the UI records your confirmation before any hourly resource is created.
Set `$CreatedAt` and `$ExpiresAt` to today's calendar date.

steps.title: Cluster and roles
bullets: Run `aws ecs create-cluster --cluster-name workbook-gl18 --tags Key=Workbook,Value=aws-tf-lab Key=LabId,Value=gl-18 Key=CreatedAt,Value=$CreatedAt Key=ExpiresAt,Value=$ExpiresAt`

Run `$Trust = @{Version='2012-10-17';Statement=@(@{Effect='Allow';Principal=@{Service='ecs-tasks.amazonaws.com'};Action='sts:AssumeRole'})} | ConvertTo-Json -Depth 10 -Compress; $utf8 = New-Object System.Text.UTF8Encoding $false; [IO.File]::WriteAllText("$pwd\gl18-trust.json", $Trust, $utf8)`. This writes the ECS task trust policy (Principal Service `ecs-tasks.amazonaws.com`) as UTF-8 without a BOM.
Run `aws iam create-role --role-name workbook-gl18-task --assume-role-policy-document file://gl18-trust.json`.
Run `aws iam attach-role-policy --role-name workbook-gl18-task --policy-arn arn:aws:iam::aws:policy/service-role/AmazonECSTaskExecutionRolePolicy`.
Run `$TaskRoleArn = aws iam get-role --role-name workbook-gl18-task --query Role.Arn --output text`.
Success: cluster and role exist.

steps.title: Task definition
bullets: Run `$TaskDefJson = @{family='workbook-gl18';networkMode='awsvpc';requiresCompatibilities=@('FARGATE');cpu='256';memory='512';executionRoleArn=$TaskRoleArn;containerDefinitions=@(@{name='app';image='public.ecr.aws/docker/library/hello-world:latest';essential=$true})} | ConvertTo-Json -Depth 10 -Compress; $utf8 = New-Object System.Text.UTF8Encoding $false; [IO.File]::WriteAllText("$pwd\gl18-task.json", $TaskDefJson, $utf8)`. This saves a Fargate task definition (awsvpc network mode, 256 CPU units, 512 MiB memory, one container) as UTF-8 without a BOM.
Run `aws ecs register-task-definition --cli-input-json file://gl18-task.json`.
Run `$TaskDef = aws ecs describe-task-definition --task-definition workbook-gl18 --query taskDefinition.taskDefinitionArn --output text`.
Success: task definition registered.

steps.title: Run task
bullets: Run `$VpcId = aws ec2 describe-vpcs --filters Name=isDefault,Values=true --query "Vpcs[0].VpcId" --output text`. Run `$SubnetId = aws ec2 describe-subnets --filters Name=vpc-id,Values=$VpcId --query "Subnets[0].SubnetId" --output text`. This picks a subnet in the default VPC for the task's `awsvpc` network configuration.

Run `$Network = @{awsvpcConfiguration=@{subnets=@($SubnetId);assignPublicIp='ENABLED'}} | ConvertTo-Json -Depth 10 -Compress; $utf8 = New-Object System.Text.UTF8Encoding $false; [IO.File]::WriteAllText("$pwd\network.json", $Network, $utf8)`. Run `aws ecs run-task --cluster workbook-gl18 --launch-type FARGATE --task-definition $TaskDef --network-configuration file://network.json`.
Success: task reaches STOPPED after the container exits.

steps.title: Scale desired to zero
bullets: This lab uses run-task only; confirm no service remains with desired > 0.
Success: no running tasks.

steps.title: Deregister task definition
bullets: Run `aws ecs deregister-task-definition --task-definition $TaskDef`.
Success: revision is INACTIVE.

steps.title: Delete cluster
bullets: Run `aws ecs delete-cluster --cluster workbook-gl18`.
Success: cluster is gone.

steps.title: Cost checkpoint
bullets: Confirm you typed `I ACCEPT THE COST RISK` in the card before any hourly create.
Fargate bills per vCPU-second and per GB-second only while a task is RUNNING; a STOPPED task stops billing immediately, and the cluster shell and task definition cost nothing to leave registered.
Re-read the same-hour and forgotten-24h estimates on this lab card.
Success: you know what still bills if you walk away overnight.

steps.title: Order the deletes
bullets: Teardown order for this lab: ECS cluster, then detach and delete the IAM role. Task definitions are free to leave registered, but the Deregister task definition step deregisters this one for tidiness.
Open Stop charges and read each PowerShell line top to bottom.
Success: dependents are deleted before parents.

steps.title: Tear the lab down
bullets: Run every Stop charges command yourself in order.
Success: `aws resourcegroupstaggingapi get-resources --tag-filters Key=LabId,Values=gl-18` returns an empty ResourceTagMappingList.

steps.title: Check the bill later
bullets: After 8–12 hours, review today's charges in the Billing console.
Record actual spend in your notes.
Leftover tagged resources (a still-RUNNING task, if any) can still bill until deleted.

hints: Use official AWS docs for exact flags.

verification: aws resourcegroupstaggingapi get-resources --tag-filters Key=LabId,Values=gl-18 returns an empty ResourceTagMappingList in $env:AWS_REGION
teardown.stillBillingNote: Time already used, transfer, tax, and 8–12h billing lag may still appear. Alerts do not delete resources.
teardown.recovery: If teardown fails, stop. Confirm $env:AWS_REGION is us-east-1 and the caller is not root. Run aws sts get-caller-identity and type that Account value before any delete. List LabId=gl-18 with aws resourcegroupstaggingapi get-resources --tag-filters Key=LabId,Values=gl-18. Delete only those ids. Never delete untagged resources.

body: ECS Fargate cluster, one short task, stop, deregister TD, delete cluster.
